channel.title: Rwanda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Rwanda, every source cited.

item.title: Rwanda trains 70 coaches in football GPS technology
item.description: The national football federation aims to improve player preparation and reduce injury risks through data analysis.

item.title: Kagame to attend Francophonie summit amid leadership contest
item.description: Rwanda's candidate Louise Mushikiwabo seeks a third term as OIF Secretary-General against DRC's Juliana Lumumba.

item.title: Rwanda signs nuclear deal with Russia
item.description: The agreement aims to develop a small modular reactor and a Centre for Nuclear Science and Technology.

item.title: Bank of Kigali marks 60 years with football and music tour
item.description: The bank's anniversary celebrations began in Rubavu with a BK Pro League match and concerts by local artists.

item.title: RPF members in Europe meet in Warsaw
item.description: Young party members from 19 European countries gathered to discuss contributing to Rwanda's development and Vision 2050 goals.
